description: LibertAI's REAP-pruned DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: the routed-expert pool is cut from 384 to 256 per layer with a modality-balanced router-weighted ranking (publisher-measured cost: text perplexity 3.6552 to 4.1723, +14.1%; caption perplexity 24.307 to 26.479, +8.9%), and nothing is re-quantized (experts MXFP4, dense layers FP8). 46 weight shards; the 189 GiB Engram tables (layers 1 and 14) are not in this repository and come from shards 47 and 48 of the official checkpoint, which this Model lists as a dependency. The checkpoint carries the vision tower and the DSpark draft stages.
